column3: Close to the Hebrew; the Hebrew of this line is obscure, and the rendering is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV follows the Masoretic “the children of Israel”; the Dead Sea Scrolls and the Greek read “the sons of God.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the apple of His eye” renders “the little man of His eye,” the pupil.
Close to the Hebrew; “Jeshurun” is a poetic name for Israel meaning “upright one.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the lowest hell” renders “the lowest Sheol.”
Close to the Hebrew; “bitter destruction” may also be read as “Resheph,” a plague figure.
